claim_boundary: Hostless actual Windows AEX GLOBAL_SETUP/PARAMS_SETUP registration compared with current Mac production. A passing gate proves only each row's declared normalized registration surface; it does not prove native AE layout, localization, interaction, rendering, or fields explicitly listed as evidence boundaries.

plugins.boundary: Pointer values, inactive union residue, localized host rendering, AE-version interpretation, and render behavior are excluded.
All 101 owned raw registration rows are exact, but per-row display-name binding/localization is unproved because the hostless AEX run does not execute the DLL/CRT string-table initializer.
Pointer-valued labels/choice strings and hostless variadic name formatting are excluded; counts, defaults, types, flags, ranges, order, and normalized values are compared.
Normalized hostless GLOBAL_SETUP and all 21 owned registration rows only; native AE control layout and rendering are excluded.
Normalized hostless GLOBAL_SETUP/PARAMS_SETUP only; AE-native layout, localization, interaction, and rendering are excluded.
All 40 owned registration rows and five ramp registrations are exact. Expanded custom-ramp drawing/interaction has not been visually proven in native AE and is not promoted by this gate.

The public 30-control registration surface is exact. Windows custom UI capability/event flags are intentionally not advertised because the corresponding Mac EVENT/USER_CHANGED/UPDATE handlers are not ported.
Three raw records and GLOBAL_SETUP are compared; name/type literals rely on the separately hash-bound retained fixture. Native AE layout and rendering are excluded.
Direct hostless actual-AEX GLOBAL_SETUP/PARAMS_SETUP comparison for all 15 owned rows; native AE layout and rendering are excluded.
Hostless actual-AEX public GLOBAL_SETUP/PARAMS_SETUP and PiPL capability literals only; native AE control layout is excluded.
